checks: timing derived from final vocal audio
no visibly early or late lyric changes
opening immediately communicates value or emotion
script is concise, accurate, modern and free of filler
visuals feel intentional, realistic and platform-native
editing rhythm matches the emotional arc
captions are clean, readable and correctly timed
music and sound design support rather than overpower the message
thumbnail/cover is clean, catchy and truthful
title and metadata accurately package the content
no visible rendering defects, awkward crops, dead frames or placeholder assets
platform safe zones, aspect ratio and export quality are correct
final piece feels coherent and professionally finished from first frame to last
final encoded file exists and is decodable
no clipping, broken audio, or export corruption
actual assembled final video watched from first frame to last
story and visual progression remain coherent through the ending
no static-image slideshow or animated-still substitute presented as professional moving video
no obvious AI anatomy, motion, continuity, text, face, hand, lip-sync, flicker, warp, or realism defects
no repeated or irrelevant B-roll filler
voice performance sounds natural and intentional
music, ambience, captions and edit support the emotional arc
thumbnail and metadata accurately represent the final master
piece is strong enough to publish even when no quota or schedule pressure exists

hardBlocks: unverified factual claim presented as certain
obvious AI anatomy/artifact in hero thumbnail
final assembled piece does not meet Professional Master standard
release vote attempted before an actual immutable assembled master exists
static-image pan/zoom or animated-still substitute used as publishable moving-video master
legacy, substituted, silently repaired, or recompressed media after approval
any content, thumbnail, caption, audio, title, description, or metadata change after approval without full re-approval
quota or scheduled slot used to justify a lower-quality release
irrelevant stock-video selection or off-theme visual sequence
V17-or-earlier render presented as V18 storyboard-compliant master
automated storyboard check presented as proof of independent visual/audio review

releaseStandard.name: PROFESSIONAL_MASTER
releaseStandard.rule: No content is publishable merely because component checks pass. The final assembled piece must pass an end-to-end professional execution review.
releaseStandard.masterReadyRule: Release voting starts only after the actual assembled video, final audio, captions/lyrics, thumbnail, metadata, rights manifest, Scripture/fact checks, safe-zone inspection, export inspection, full-watch review, and immutable master hash exist.
releaseStandard.certificationRule: TECHNICAL_MASTER=PASS and CREATIVE_MASTER=PASS and all required QA=PASS and exact-hash 49 approvals plus Publisher-last approval. Any subsequent media or metadata change invalidates certification and approvals.

visualStoryContract.caseStudy: DO NOT CARRY TOMORROW V3 — planned sunrise / cave / sunrise
productionRules: Use each scene to support the corresponding narration or Scripture, with an intentional emotional and visual progression.
Do not select stock footage by numeric index or use uncurated fallback footage when an original video provider fails.
Stock scenes must have explicit source IDs, provenance, story-beat purpose and, for an intentional reprise, a different source trim.
Do not use unrelated exercise, airplane or travel B-roll simply to fill duration.
When a topic lacks curated footage, try original free motion video; if real coherent motion cannot be rendered, hold the master for production, do not publish.
Technical storyboard matching does not certify the actual visual story; independently review the exact final master before release.
visualStoryContract.legacyMasterPolicy: V17 and older renders lack this enforceable storyboard inspection and need a new version-bound master and full independent review.
visualStoryContract.releaseRule: No old 50-agent approval can be transferred to a newly rendered, revised, caption-adjusted, recompressed or re-trimmed master.
